about: Operator declarations about library avatars that their files cannot carry. depictsAdult: true allows swimwear and underwear for that avatar (wardrobe/policy/intimate.py). Set it only for an avatar the operator has decided depicts an adult; the model's own sexual-usage terms are still checked first. Every avatar in this library is declared adult by the operator: the public built-in avatars of 3D-Avatar-Chatbot (vendor/avatars/avatars.json) on 2026-11-07, and the three VRoid Hub models (AvatarSample_O, Model Girl, Rinna) on 2026-11-13.
